name: File List
description: Lists a directory as a table: path, name, extension, size, modification time and is_directory. Walks the tree with Java NIO without following symlinks, skips hidden entries by default, filters by a glob pattern on the file name, sorts the result and caps it with limit.

directory.title: Directory
directory.description: Directory to list; it must exist.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Glob pattern matched against the file name, e.g. *.csv.

recursive.title: Recursive
recursive.description: Walk subdirectories; symlinked directories are never followed.

include_hidden.title: Include hidden
include_hidden.description: Include entries whose name starts with a dot.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort order of the listing, ascending; ties are broken by path.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries returned; 1000 by default.
